title: Onboarding Tour

generate.title: Generate onboarding tour
generate.body: DevDigest indexes the repo and specs, then writes a 5-section guided tour: overview, architecture, key modules, getting started, and conventions & gotchas.

notIndexed.title: This repository isn’t indexed
notIndexed.body: The import graph is empty, so there are no reading-path facts to build a tour from. Re-sync the repository to index it, then generate the tour.

flagOff.title: Repository intelligence is switched off
flagOff.body: The tour is built from the code index, and indexing is disabled by configuration on this server. This is a setting, not a failed index.

noKey.title: No provider key configured
noKey.body: Generating a tour needs a key for the model configured for onboarding. Add one in Settings and the action becomes available.

noModel.title: Written without a model
noModel.body: The model call failed, so this tour was built from the indexed facts alone. The structure is complete; the prose is not. Regenerating retries the call.

stale.title: Written for a different commit
stale.body: This tour describes an earlier commit than the repository’s current head, so a file may have moved since. Every link still opens the commit the tour was written for.

hotnessNote: The reading path reflects import rank alone. Change frequency is not measured, so a file that changes constantly is not ranked any higher for it.
droppedLinks: {count} link(s) were dropped because the path is not in this repository’s indexed file set.

errorState.body: The tour could not be loaded: {reason}

linkLabel: Open {path} on GitHub, at the commit this tour was written for
